title: Oozing Polish Tofu Curry
description: Salty, gooey weeknight Polish tofu curry with smoked flavor from panang paste, served over rice.
instructions: Heat the sunflower oil in a large skillet over medium heat until shimmering.
Add the tofu cubes and sauté until golden brown on all sides, about 4-5 minutes; remove to a plate.
Stir in the low-FODMAP panang curry paste, ground ginger, and ground turmeric for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and soy sauce, whisking to combine and bring to a gentle simmer.
Return the tofu to the skillet, stir to coat, and simmer for 5 minutes to let flavors meld.
Season the curry with smoked salt and lemon juice, stir well, and taste.
Remove from heat, fold in fresh chopped dill, and let the dish rest for 2 minutes.
Serve hot over steamed rice or low-FODMAP noodles, spooning extra coconut sauce over the tofu.
